svg.title: Single-object tracking and DINOv2 recovery
svg.desc: Example 08 Normal update first; search only on observed failure
svg.text: Single-object tracking and DINOv2 recovery
Example 08 Normal update first; search only on observed failure
Prepare the models and initialize the target
Frame-0 predicted mask selects the target instance
Warm pose updates and search groups before timing
Propagate the target region with DINOv2
Encode each raw RGB frame and update its matching region
Read sensor depth on the pose-update frame
Complete the normal WAPR / SAPR update
Preserve previous rotation; use region depth for translation
WBPS within_group chooses among six normal hypotheses
Check whether search is needed
Missing region, depth disagreement or area collapse
Also check the complete-group WBPS error > 0
If triggered, search local and global DINOv2 patches
Up to six local + six global; depth gates and spatial separation
Keep previous rotation; batch-refine all translation seeds
Compare the normal result with refined search candidates
WBPS within_group selects the final pose
No candidates or failed search: retain the normal result
Continue with this track’s own state
Patch recovery supplies a pose, not a new segmentation mask
A selected candidate is not a guarantee of accurate recovery
Time normal computation, search, refinement, scoring and state writes
Ground truth is for offline evaluation; no 2D detector is used for recovery
